title: Vice Beach: Coastal Nine Golf
description: Tee off along nine sunlit Miami-bay links holes! Hold Space to nail the gold sweet spot, curve drives over tidal inlets, and outplay three rivals under palm-fringed sunset skies.
controls: Drag / WASD or Arrows aim, Q/E or Scroll switch club, F shot type, hold & release Space to swing, Shift preview, R reset.

zh-CN.title: 罪恶海滩：滨海九洞高尔夫
zh-CN.description: 面朝碧海棕榈挥杆打满九洞！按住空格蓄力卡准金色完美区，一杆飞越海湾潮口、果岭精准推杆，还能随时和三位电脑对手同场比杆。
zh-CN.controls: 拖拽或 WASD/方向键瞄准，滚轮或 Q/E 换杆，F 切球路，按住空格蓄力松手击球，Shift 预览落点，右上角可切换中英文。
